RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning your sex was not a disadvantage relative to the person hired. Raising the panel's gender composition would weaken your standing, as an all-male panel selecting one man over another does not support an allegation of sex discrimination.

While an all-male committee may reflect broader organizational diversity concerns, it provides no evidence of bias against you individually. Instead, focus your inquiries on objective criteria: your master's degree, five years of deputy principal experience, and the delayed written explanation. Pursuing procedural transparency and merit-based scoring will be far more credible and productive.
